LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Jian.label: jian
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Jian.description: A straight double-edged sword, light and quick, used with precise thrusts and flicks of the wrist.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Jian.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Jian.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Jian.tools.2.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Guandao.label: guandao
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Guandao.description: A heavy curved blade on a long pole with a dragon-head guard, swung in great sweeping arcs.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Guandao.tools.0.label: shaft
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Guandao.tools.1.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Repeater.label: repeating crossbow
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Repeater.description: A crossbow with a box of ten bolts mounted on top. It throws three light bolts in quick succession, then must be reloaded.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Repeater.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireLance.label: fire lance
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireLance.description: A spear with a bamboo tube of black powder lashed behind the head. Lit, it spits a short jet of fire that sets targets alight; then it is only a spear again.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireLance.tools.0.label: shaft
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireLance.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Dao.label: dao
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Dao.description: The broad sabre of the common soldier, with a disc guard and a red tassel. It cuts deep and is easy to learn.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Dao.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Dao.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Dao.tools.2.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BirdGun.label: bird gun
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BirdGun.description: The long, slender matchlock called the bird gun: accurate enough to hit a bird in flight, light enough to carry all day.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BirdGun.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_BirdGun.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Rifle.label: Tianxia rifle
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Rifle.description: A bolt rifle from the new arsenals, its dark red stock bound in brass and a red tassel at the muzzle for luck. Made by the thousand, it needs less work and fewer parts than any other rifle.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Rifle.tools.0.label: stock
